name: Springtail Slicer
tagline: A native macOS slicer with a glass cockpit.
description: Springtail is a small, fast, native macOS slicer. SwiftUI and SceneKit in front, a headless static build of PrusaSlicer's libslic3r behind it, and a Liquid Glass interface on top.

It is deliberately not a PrusaSlicer skin. The app never links wxWidgets, never starts OpenGL, and never loads a GUI toolkit. The window you see is SwiftUI; the slicing core is a quiet CLI process that only runs when you press Slice.
AnkerMake M5 and M5C profiles ship in the box, and finished G-code drops straight into EufyMake Sender.

features.title: Native 3D canvas
features.body: SceneKit renders the model, the build plate, and sliced toolpaths. Orbit, pan, and zoom feel native.

features.title: Headless libslic3r
features.body: A static arm64 engine built from PrusaSlicer 2.9.6 with the GUI compiled out. No wxWidgets, no OpenGL.

features.title: Real G-code preview
features.body: Toolpaths parsed per layer, coloured by feature type, with a layer slider and separate travel-move toggle.

features.title: Liquid Glass chrome
features.body: Floating glass panels, glass buttons, and a glass layer scrubber over the 3D scene.

features.title: AnkerMake profiles included
features.body: AnkerMake M5 and M5C print profiles at 0.10/0.20/0.30 mm, plus Generic PLA, PETG, and ABS filament profiles.
